name: Zombuul
ability: Each night*, if no-one died today, choose a player: they die. The 1st time you die, you live but register as dead.
wakes: Each night except the first, only if no player died that day (no DIED TODAY reminder).
interaction: Points at a player, who dies. The first time it dies it is announced dead and its life token is flipped (no shroud), but it stays alive and registers as dead.
drunk_or_poisoned: The kill fails; if it dies while drunk or poisoned it truly dies and good wins.

rulings.text: After its first death the Zombuul is treated as dead in nearly every respect (one ghost vote, cannot nominate), but it is truly alive: the game continues when only two other players are alive.
The second death is real; good wins.
Executing an already-dead player is not a death, so the Zombuul can still wake that night.
If an apparently dead Zombuul becomes drunk or poisoned, do not announce that it is alive.
If the Zombuul is executed (first death), it is marked DIED TODAY and does not wake that night.

test_scenarios.name: wakes when no deaths
test_scenarios.actions: Day 1: no execution. Night 2: Zombuul chooses Bob.

test_scenarios.name: sleeps after a death
test_scenarios.expected: The Zombuul does not wake night 3; no night death.

test_scenarios.name: first death survived
test_scenarios.expected: Alice is announced dead but stays alive, registering dead; the game continues; she does not wake night 3.

test_scenarios.name: second death real
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Zombuul has already died once

test_scenarios.name: executing a dead player
test_scenarios.actions: Day 3: Dave executed; nobody else dies.
test_scenarios.expected: The Zombuul wakes night 4 and kills.
